title: Ninne Ne Aaradinthunu – Ravinder Vottepu Telugu Christian Lyrics

credits.Lyrics, Composition, Vocals: Pastor Ravinder Vottepu, Adimalla Sudheer Kumar, Suresh Garugula

intro: Ninne Ne Aaradinthunu is the latest Christian Telugu song from the album, Athi Parishudha Stalamu Nundi written, composed and sung by Pastor Ravinder Vottepu, Adimalla Sudheer Kumar, Suresh Garugula and music composed by Bro. Jakie Vardhan. This song was released on December 22, 2019 through Sons Ministries.
